description: The engine ABI engine-ddi builds against. tools/build/build-engine-ddi.ps1 refuses a header whose SHA-256 differs, and an engine DLL that is not the one its -Flavour pins. The release and the lab flavour (BD-167) are two builds of one source line, so each pins its own DLL; tools/build/engine_abi.py selects one, with the semantics of tools/release/release_flavour.py.
header_revision: r5-draft with optional view-instancing contract revision 1

release.engine_dll_recipe: tools/build/build-vkd3d.ps1 -Config ddi-engine-lto (no -Lab, so no diagnostic variable and no statistics counter); pinned from the tester.31 build. The single pin before the two flavours named the vi-r2 snapshot engine, engine-x64/libs/ddi and 80217882D8BEB3BB0115E006034A380D12ED03BD10398EBC372A78027178CBA6

lab.engine_dll_recipe: tools/build/build-vkd3d.ps1 -Config ddi-engine-lto -Lab (the same option set plus -Damdgpu-wddm-lab-flavour=true, from the same source line); pinned from the tester.31 build
